description: Primary Parity Before the Cutover: Staff student view (Preview mode)
deviation_notes: Phase A prepared only: the kit run and the captures are a batch step (orchestrator). legacyPath holds raw legacy ids. The go/no-go block 'staff ...' reads pages only. S3 added 15 copy keys that are English in th, cn, tw, vi (owner translation pass). No sample-words line inside the apk game (check in batch). Defaults used: D8 SYSTEM school rule, preview book in independent mode, banner design of Phase 0. Closed 2026-10-26 (Daniel, check D2).

sprint.goal: A teacher, a school admin, and a SYSTEM user open each student page from the account menu, see what a student of their school sees, and no student record changes.
